sermon.title: Jesus Came to Encourage Morality
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer presents Jesus as coming to save sinners and encourage morality through repentance—not faith-without-change. He parallels Ahaz’s decline signs, rejects mixing all religions, shows religion and civil power killing Jesus, cites modern martyrdom and American leaders who stood with God, and calls moral Americans to unite in a moral mutiny.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Unverified: “more Christians murdered since 1900 than all prior centuries”; Reagan “16 million jobs.” Named Washington/Roosevelt/Reagan, Iran deal, Hindus/Muslims, SCOTUS liberals kept as spoken.

chunks.section_question: Why did Jesus Christ come into the world?

faqs.question: Was Jesus’ goal a moral mutiny?
faqs.answer: Like Hezekiah, Jesus came to the whole world to encourage morality—a mutiny toward good, truth and honesty.

faqs.question: How does Abraham’s seed bless the families of the earth?

scriptures.text_nkjv: Now to Abraham and his Seed were the promises made. He does not say, “And to seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “And to your Seed,” who is Christ.

faqs.question: What fruit proves repentance?
faqs.answer: If I was a thief I am not a thief anymore; if sexually immoral, not anymore—fruit consistent with repentance.

faqs.question: Is “just believe in Jesus” enough if lifestyle never changes?
faqs.answer: He rejects permissiveness by faith and grace that says it doesn’t matter what you do—you’re going to heaven.

faqs.question: Were John and Jesus arrested for applying Bible morality to justice?
faqs.answer: Yes—he says both were arrested for using the Bible in legal issues and judicial justice.

faqs.question: Should Christians prioritize being politically correct?
faqs.answer: He says America emphasizes political correctness; Jesus just said the truth.

faqs.question: What leaven did Jesus warn about?
faqs.answer: Leaven of the doctrine of the Pharisees, Sadducees and Herod—religious parties and government.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.”

faqs.question: What Pearl Harbor-era resolve does he cite?
faqs.answer: Roosevelt that we will conquer our enemies after Japan bombed Pearl Harbor, ending with “so help us God.”

faqs.question: What does he say Reagan promoted?
faqs.answer: Moral family values and creating 16 million new jobs by economic policies—figures as spoken.

faqs.question: What should America’s morally inclined people do?
faqs.answer: Speak up, unite and have a moral mutiny.
